mostWorthwhile.text: Building the printing press was most worthwhile: the explanation connected the carved block, screw and paper to the process of making copies.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the pendulum was a brief, predictable step with little explanation on its own.

surprise.text: I expected a press component, but combining the printing block and iron produced the complete press; its screw mechanism clarified how it worked.

arbitrary.text: The clockwork combination felt somewhat underexplained until the finished clock described the gears counting pendulum swings.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see another project with a concrete mechanism explained as clearly as the printing press, though the later single-option steps offered fewer decisions.
